rows.label: Five medieval-studies courses at the 2000 level or above, at least 15 credits in all
rows.note: Counts courses listed or cross-listed under the MEDVL subject at 2000 or above. Courses outside MEDVL that the program approves by petition, and study-abroad courses, are not matched by the board.

rows.label: Spread the five courses over at least two different areas of study
rows.note: The board cannot tell a course's area of study (literature, art history, philosophy, archaeology and so on), so you confirm this.

rows.label: Earn C- or better in each course counted toward the minor
Submit a short exit statement (about 300 words) before the end of your final semester
rows.note: The statement describes the intellectual interests you developed through the minor's coursework.
